title: New Lights on Old Paths
author: Charles Foster

authorInfo.bio: Charles Foster (1822–1887) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "New Lights on Old Paths" by Charles Foster is a collection of moral tales and fables written in the late 19th century. The work aims to revisit and apply timeless morals to contemporary life, suggesting that the author believes in the importance of applying old truths rather than seeking new ones.
